page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a faint show-through of the facing page's text behind it (not transcribed). Running head at top with page number at left. No margin notes. Catchword-like marginal fragment "Appen-" at lower right is a catchword at the foot of the text.

main_text.p: Zione Legem tuam prodire volueris. Bonitas Tua est, quòd cùm alij horâ demum nonâ aut undecimâ in Vineam Tuam sunt vocati, nobis sancta hæc cultura ab ipso diluculo fuerit commissa. Hanc rogamus, per Jesum Christum, Cœlestem illum Doctorem, Magistrum nostrum ἀνυπόδῠτον, gratiam in nobis conserva, auge, & si nostris aliquid, addere audeamus votis, ad seros propagare, nepotes clementer perge: Donec ex hac Schola crucis in Lucis Scholam promoti, æternis fruamur gaudijs. Hanc nobis concede gratiam ad Sanctissimi Nominis Tui gloriam, Reipub. Christianæ emolumentum, bonarum Literarum incrementum, Ecclesiæ augmentum, sempiternam denique animarum salutem:

page.notes: Greek word in the text ("ἀνυπόδῠτον") is a printed Greek epithet, somewhat blurred; reading uncertain. Faint show-through of the reverse page text throughout; not transcribed. Lower-right "Appen-" is a catchword rather than a note.
